Name: Only Fruits
Author: rosebunnypuppy
Description:
[size=6][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The "Only Fruits" challenge run was created by CozyAndCaffeinated. Please go support her!

    [url=https://linktr.ee/CozyandCaffeinated]https://linktr.ee/CozyandCaffeinated[/url]
    [url=https://www.youtube.com/@cozyandcaffeinated]https://www.youtube.com/@cozyandcaffeinated[/url]

You can find a youtube playlist of the series [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udju_3aAqQw&list=PLHZ9MvcxjqCXWM-FMpDtWZ9UUWY7U9x8A]here[/url]

She came up with the challenge, all I've done is convert the ruleset into a mod. I have NO affiliation with her, I am just a fan of their work. Any views, phrasing, comments, statements, or opinions expressed within this mod are those of the individual who wrote them, and do not necessarily reflect the official policy, position, or opinions of CozyAndCaffeinated.[/color]

[[url=https://github.com/RoseBunnyPuppy/OnlyFruits]GitHub Source[/url]]

[size=6][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] (follow the instructions for your ope[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098Install]GenericModConfigMenu[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the zip for this mod, unzip it, and place the folder in your `Mods/` folder[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=6][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod makes a few changes to the way the game works.
[size=5]Sale Price[/size]
This mod sets the sell price (i.e. the amount that a player gets if they try to sell an item) of ALL items (except the following) to 0:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Fruits (see the list [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fruits]here[/url])[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Cooking recipes that use a fruit as an ingredient, except for the following[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Summer Seeds[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fall Seeds [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Winter Seeds [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Warp Totem: Desert[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The following artisanal goods:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Jelly[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Wine[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Raisins[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dried Fruit[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Some meme items that Lavender's community decided along the way[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]ch- ch- ch- ch- Cherry Bombs[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Some stuff we figured should've been considered fruit[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Sweet Gem Berries[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Quest Rewards[/size]
Since one of the purposes of the challenge is to make money Only using Fruits, quests that reward money via non-fruits have their money/gem rewards dropped down to 0.

For a few of the vanilla quests that have requirements that can either be a fruit or a non-fruit, this mod removes the non-fruit choices.[/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Lewis's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Quests#Crop_Order]Crop Order quest[/url] now has the following possible requirements:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Spring: Strawberry[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Summer: Blueberry, Melon, Hot Pepper[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fall:  Cranberries, Grape[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*] Caroline's [Island Ingredients quest](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Quests#Island_Ingredients) now has the following possible requirements:
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pineapple[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Daily Quests[/size]
Non-fruit daily quests will have their monetary rewards set to 0. The reward will be restored if the challenge is disabled.

[size=5]Trash Can Behavior[/size]
Because not every item has a changeable sell price (e.g. trinkets, boots, weapons), the upgraded trash cans can be used to get money from them. I've disabled the upgraded trash cans, and if a save is loaded with an upgraded trash can, your trash can will be downgraded to the basic one that doesn't give any monies upon trashing!
If you later disable the mod, then your original trash can level will be restored (i.e. if you had a gold trash can before enabling the mod, you will have a gold trash can once it is disabled)[/color]

[size=6][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] (follow the instructions for your operating system)[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098Install]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]  [/*]
[/list]
[size=6][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to CozyAndCaffeinated for the idea behind the challenge run![/color]
